image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a wombat peering out from the entrance of a burrow. The animal's head and shoulders are visible, framed by the rough, textured opening of the tunnel. The lighting is somewhat dim inside the burrow, highlighting the coarse texture of the wombat's fur and its broad, blunt snout.
